# From Shapetaker

`entanglement/constellation.hpp` is the FM topology generator of the
Entanglement module in the Shapetaker VCV Rack plugin, by the same author as
Apotheca, copied here unchanged. It has no VCV Rack code in it. QMOD
(`engine/src/qmod.cpp`) uses it to make its sounds; QMOD's voice is its own
and much lighter than the module's.

To update it, copy the file again. Do not edit it here.
